reconfigure.title: {model}
reconfigure.description: How this model should speak a reply that is still being written.

data_description.stream_mode: Buffered renders the whole reply before any of it plays — the longest wait, but it never stalls. Sentence sends each finished sentence on its own. Coalesced does the same but sends together whatever arrived while the previous sentence was still being spoken, which removes the pause at each sentence boundary.
data_description.head_start: Seconds of audio to bank before a streamed reply starts playing. A model that renders slower than its audio plays falls behind for the whole reply and never catches up, and this is the difference handed over in advance. Leave at 0 for a model that keeps ahead. The cost is paid on time to first audio, and only up to what the reply can actually lose: a one-line answer waits a fraction of it.

abort.model_comes_from_the_server: Models are not added here. Download one in the Cortex TTS app and it appears on this page by itself.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. It applies to the next reply.
